heading: The default: schema-fixed TTL
text:
### The default: schema-fixed TTL [LDTL.1.1]

Every `ttl`-lifecycle schema declares its TTL at the schema level, and every
fact of the schema expires that long after it enters working memory:

$\mathit{deadline} = t_{\mathit{assert}} + d_s$

where $t_{\mathit{assert}}$ is the fact's entry stamp ([LTIM.2.8.6]) and $d_s$
the schema's declared TTL, a **compile-time constant** fixed at DSC load.

This is the default and the common case.  Because all facts of the same
schema expire in assertion order (FIFO), the engine can use a
**per-schema FIFO TTL queue** — no deadline heap, O(1) per assert and
O(expired × log n_ttl_schemas + n_ttl_schemas) per tick ([LDTL.3.1],
[LDTL.6.3]). The engine's tick in this edition costs [LDTL.6.4]'s.
